title: Photosynthesis - Light-Dependent Reactions
body:
Study the diagram of a chloroplast below:

```
[CHLOROPLAST DIAGRAM]
         OUTER MEMBRANE
    ________________________
   |   STROMA              |
   |    _______            |
   |   |THYLAKOID|--GRANUM  |
   |   |_MEMBRANE_|         |
   |      (stacked)         |
   |________________________|
         INNER MEMBRANE
```

The light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis occur in a specific part of the chloroplast. Identify this location and explain what happens during these reactions.
